description: This file defines an interface `QueryBuilderFactory` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.model.query`. The interface provides factory methods for creating `QueryBuilder` instances, either with or without a default limit, based on given `Criteria`. It serves as a factory interface that facilitates the creation of query builder objects used for constructing queries in the Ditto model.

classes.name: QueryBuilderFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating `QueryBuilder` objects based on given `Criteria`. Provides methods to generate builders with or without default limits for streaming purposes.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new `QueryBuilder` based on provided `Criteria`. Throws `NullPointerException` if `criteria` is null.

methods.name: newUnlimitedBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new `QueryBuilder` without a default limit, useful for streaming. Throws `NullPointerException` if `criteria` is null.
